props.name: layers
props.description: Top layer first, in composition px (origin top-left). Layer: {type: shape|solid|null|precomp|text, id?, parent?: id, in?/out? ms, transform?: {anchor, position [x,y], scale [100,100] %, rotation deg clockwise, opacity 0–100}, shapes: […], matte?: {source: id, mode: alpha|luma}, masks?: [{path, mode: add|subtract|intersect}]}. Shapes draw top first; a style paints the shapes before it in its group: rect {position (centre), size, radius}, ellipse {position, size}, star|polygon {points, outerRadius, innerRadius}, path {d: SVG path}; fill {color}, stroke {color, width, cap, join, dash: [len, gap]}, gradient-fill {kind: linear|radial, start, end, stops: [[0, colour], [1, colour]]}; trim {start, end, offset} (percent, draw-on lines), repeater {copies, transform}, round-corners {radius}; group {shapes, transform}. Colours: $color.* tokens (light/dark), #hex or {light, dark}. Animate any value: {keys: [{t: ms, v: value, ease: linear|ease-in|ease-out|ease-in-out|hold|[x1,y1,x2,y2]}, …]}; tokens cannot animate. Keep it small; loops end on the first pose. No expressions.
